mapper.delete: DELETE FROM selection_wish WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND sid = #{sid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO selection_wish (round_id, sid, course_id, priority) VALUES (#{roundId}, #{sid}, #{courseId}, #{priority})
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.round_id, w.sid, w.course_id, w.priority, w.create_time, c.name AS courseName, c.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection cs WHERE cs.course_id = w.course_id) AS selectedCount FROM selection_wish w LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = w.course_id WHERE w.round_id = #{roundId} AND w.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY w.priority

SELECT w.id, w.round_id, w.sid, w.course_id, w.priority, w.create_time, c.name AS courseName FROM selection_wish w LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = w.course_id WHERE w.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY w.priority, w.create_time
